text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that compiles and compares historical greenhouse gas emissions data across Africa from 1990–2018 using bottom-up and top-down methods. It does not include any future land use/land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation. The study focuses on emissions estimation—particularly CO₂, CH₄, and N₂O—including fluxes from the LULUCF sector—but only analyzes past trends with no forward-looking scenarios or LULC projections. It fails the core inclusion criterion of implementing ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison and lacks any spatially explicit LULC prediction model. While LULUCF fluxes are discussed, they are derived from inventories, process-based models (DGVMs), or inversions representing historical periods, not predictive modeling. Thus, it meets exclusion criterion: "Purely Qualitative/Historical analysis only (no future projections)" and "No LULC prediction component.")
